records.public_claim_text: New evidence from labor markets and patent filings suggests that the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in capital markets is likely to increase significantly in the near future, and analyses of pricing patterns and trading dynamics already show changes in some markets consistent with the adoption of these new technologies.
